title: Terrain slope — Horn kernel on the inclined plane z=2x

assertions.derivation: Metric grid contract: EPSG:32648 with 1 m cells so the closed form slope=atan(dz/dcell) holds.

Horn needs a 3x3 neighbourhood; the documented platform convention marks the 1-pixel border undefined: 124/1024=0.12109375, plus/minus one pixel (1/1024). Catches submissions that fill the border with estimates.

KNOWN_ANSWER_MATRIX terrain family: the Horn 3x3 kernel is EXACT on linear surfaces. On z=2x with 1 m cells the interior slope is atan(2)=1.10714871779 rad everywhere, so mean=atan(2) and population sigma=0 (Float32 rounding of a constant is constant).
Every valid pixel is the same closed form atan(2)+-1e-6; catches degrees-instead-of-radians (63.43) and wrong-axis gradients (0).
